capture_method: serial.Serial(port,921600, timeout=1) read(4096) -> wb no parsing/filtering during capture
event_logger: tools/csi_capture/event_logger.py — sidecar wall_clock_ns + chip_seq sync 100ms tolerance
raw_invariant: RAW written once binary then chmod a-w; never modified; parser handles glued fragments via re.finditer

trial_duration_s.note: D walking 2 traversals ~15s each; reference speed 0.8-1.2 m/s target only (§2.D)

valid_trial_criteria.walking_speed_not_gate: speed outside 0.8-1.2 does NOT invalidate; logged as covariate

backup.rule: NO HUMAN DATA COLLECTION UNTIL PERSISTENT BACKUP HAS BEEN VERIFIED (§5.5)
backup.per_trial: copy (not move) raw/metadata/events/env/analysis + sha256sum -c + backup_verified flag

analysis.features: tools/csi_analysis/features.py — amp sqrt(I2+Q2), phase atan2 detrended
analysis.baseline: tools/csi_analysis/baseline_model.py — mu sigma cov deviation + walking covariate
analysis.pca: tools/csi_analysis/pca_spectrogram.py — PCA on baseline, STFT 2s 90% overlap
